desc: Wurlitzer EP200 reed electric piano, 4 velocity layers pp/mp/f/ff (soft = sweet and hollow, hard = gritty/honky bark). Range A1-C7 (MIDI 33-96), best C2-C6. Soul, 60s-70s pop/rock, indie, lo-fi, Motown and gospel comping; short natural decay. | Playable MIDI 33-96 (A1-C7), 4 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: pedal=1 lets notes ring until the next chord (sustain pedal, re-pedals on each new note); human 0-1 adds timing/level life; velcurve <1.6 = soft notes louder; bright = velocity opens tone; keytrack = high notes brighter.
